in_marathi.name: Surjo
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surjo हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Surjo is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Surya’, which means ‘Sun’. The name is a tribute to the Hindu Sun God, Surya, who is revered for his power, strength, and ability to provide light and warmth.
